notes.title: Find out which guest of the hotel you are most like 👀
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have something a little bit different (...and [b]interactive [/b]👀) for you today. 

Have you ever wondered which of the hotel's guests are you most like? Perhaps you see yourself in the Nursery babies, that can't keep still, or maybe the sloths from the Spa remind you of those friends that always get the lowest cleaning scores...

We at Tapioca Games [i]needed [/i]to get answers to this vital question, so we have created our own ✨[b]personality quiz[/b]✨ to find out [b]which guest of the Empyreum Hotel you'd be[/b]: 

[h3]📝[url=https://uquiz.com/edg8eF]https://uquiz.com/edg8eF[/url][/h3]

If you try it out, share your result in the comments!!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is just a small update to fix achievement "Bon Voyage! (Leave the entire hotel 100% clean)", which wasn't unlocking for some players after they had cleaned 100% of every level. We believe this happened if the last level where you got a 100% score was the "top floor" of the hotel (if you know, you know...).

[b]For those affected:[/b] The achievement should know unlock as soon as you get 100% again in [b]any level[/b]. If it still doesn't unlock for you, please, let us know!

We'd also like to remind you that you can report any bug or issue you find through this form: https://forms.gle/d4cwCTUKGKgMDctP7


We apologize for any inconvenience, and thank you for your help!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 notes + Bug report form
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for supporting Welcome to Empyreum. We have just released an update to address a few bugs that were reported during these past two weeks.

Here's a list of all the changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in the Nursery levels where babies created invisible puddles below the floor that could not be cleaned, and therefore it was not possible to obtain a 100% score.
[*]Fixed the Bakery's wooden pallet getting stuck in some walls.
[*]Fixed asleep players not being able to move after being woken up with a slap in Castle levels.
[*]Fixed a bug in the Castle's gear pedestals that allowed players to place more than one gear on them, but only one gear could be removed. This meant that all other gears that had been placed in the same pedestal couldn't be recovered and the level couldn't be finished. Now, pedestals only take one gear.
[*]Fixed Shadows quality level not being applied nor saved in the Graphics Settings.
[*]Reduced the amount of dust you need to vacuum in order to unlock achievement "No more dust" to 1000 specks. Players that have already vacuumed more than that should obtain the achievement automatically shortly after starting the game.
[/list]

We have also created a [b]form [/b]where you can submit any other bugs you might find from now on: [url=https://forms.gle/d4cwCTUKGKgMDctP7]https://forms.gle/d4cwCTUKGKgMDctP7[/url]

Thank you once again for your help, we hope that you keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: ¡Welcome to Empyreum is out NOW!
notes.content:
The wait is over!

[h2]Welcome to Empyreum is now available on Steam![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/c3eff75becf9a4a6ed3590f24ddc159a557efec2.png[/img]

We are so thrilled to let you know that you can finally play the whole game, meet our protagonists, unravel the hotel's story, and, most importantly, leave every corner squeaky clean!

Our guests are counting on you to make their experience in the Empyreum a complete delight. Arm yourself with mops, vacuum cleaners and a lot of patience; and ask your friends to give you a hand! Well, at least if they are willing to help, otherwise... We'll take no responsibility for any broken friendships 😬

Thank you for your support from the bottom of our hearts, we hope you enjoy the game.

We can say it for real now: Welcome to Empyreum!

notes.title: D Day is coming...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Just passing by to remind you that... There's only a week left for launch! This is our current mood: 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/16b22526b82546521193b43f66a6ebe42d29c5fd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/fb57fc762f4d47d0993d1d48fc65af62ec2fb281.jpg[/img][/url]

If you follow us in [url=https://linktr.ee/TapiocaGames]our social media[/url], you'll know that this is Tommy, our favourite scaly influencer. If you don't, what better chance than right now to introduce you to the four characters that you will play as in Welcome to Empyreum?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/ceaa6740997027da59c8e1556989f6f7581c87ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]🐸Tommy🐸[/h3]

Tommy is the first lizard we ever hire! He claims he was a human before entering the hotel, but who knows...

He's one of the youngest of the group and enjoys taking pictures to upload to his social media. He's a popular influencer where he comes from! 🤳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/bfefb5d4e2b4e163b91873f224893278590d2b6f.jpg[/img]

[h3]🍀Elisabeth🍀[/h3]

Elisabeth is one of the newest employees of the hotel. Since she set foot in the reception, everything seems to be going south for her, and she's convinced all her good luck has vanished. 

Nevertheless, she'll try her best to make the guests happy ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/43af46cebe980f23ae1cba7610f64fb8f56cfb1c.jpg[/img]

[h3]🎹Apolo🎹[/h3]

Apolo is the Empyreum Hotel's bad-tempered and grumpy musician.

Although he was hired to play the piano for the guests, he has forgotten how to play and now has no choice but to clean the rooms along the other new employees... Which he doesn't really enjoy at first 😶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/cafb7994e9c86a1c143b7493e5a9f5abd24af858.jpg[/img]

[h3]📷Miriam📷[/h3]

Miriam is the glue that holds the group together, always ready to lend a helping hand and cheer up the others.

She was carrying a very fogged photograph in her pocket when she arrived at the hotel, could it be a picture of someone important to her? 🤔

No matter if you play with friends or on your own, our four employees of the month will join you in the adventure and you'll discover not only the hotel's story, but also theirs. How did they end up here? What do they long for? Would Apolo trade his hat for a cat ears headband?

Tell us who you are going to [strike]adopt[/strike] choose to play as!

notes.title: Release date reveal + official languages!
notes.content:
We bear great news!! 🥳🥳

We can finally unveil the surprise we've been keeping for a while: Welcome to Empyreum has an official release date!

Gather your friends and get your cleaning kits ready, the Empyreum Hotel will open its doors...

[h2]🛎️[b]on the 20th of September![/b]🛎️[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520341/bb4c6ed67cfead7e9f9a8ba2341f1fea34345f6e.png[/img]

We are also happy to announce that you *might* be able to play in your mother tongue, since the game is coming in [b]9 languages[/b]:

🗨️Español
🗯️English
💭Français
🗨️Deutsch
🗯️Italiano
💭Portugués
🗨️Русский
🗯️日本語
💭汉语

If you can't wait any longer, remember that our demo with the first 7 levels is still available. Check it out before the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url] ends! 

See you around the hotel very, very soon 🚀
